title: fix(providers): default Claude Agent SDK to claude-sonnet-4-6 and update examples

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,3 @@
+The Claude Agent SDK provider now defaults to `claude-sonnet-4-6` and the
+Claude-provider example workflows use it too, replacing `claude-sonnet-4-5`,
+which Anthropic retires on 2026-11-30.

@@ -68,7 +68,7 @@ workflow:
   runtime:
     # The bare shorthand resolves to `native_tools: none`.
     provider: claude-agent-sdk
-    default_model: claude-sonnet-4-5
+    default_model: claude-sonnet-4-6
     max_agent_iterations: 20
 
     mcp_servers:

@@ -52,9 +52,9 @@ workflow:
       # Explicit opt-in to the built-in Claude Code tools. Without it an agent
       # that omits `tools:` gets none, and could not read README.md.
       native_tools: claude_code
-    # claude-sonnet-4-5 is the SDK's documented default; adjust to whatever
+    # claude-sonnet-4-6 is a current Sonnet model; adjust to whatever
     # your Claude Code backend (anthropic.com / Vertex AI / Bedrock) expects.
-    default_model: claude-sonnet-4-5
+    default_model: claude-sonnet-4-6
 
   input:
     question:

       # grants filesystem, shell, web and editing tools with automatic

     # The loop is bounded by max_iterations as well as by the script's verdict,

 # one. The string must match a model alias accepted by the upstream

@@ -466,3 +466,23 @@ def test_every_claude_agent_sdk_example_is_classified(self) -> None:
                 on_provider.add(path.name)
 
         assert on_provider == set(self._INTENDED)
+
+
+class TestClaudeExampleModels:
+    """Examples that run on a Claude provider must not pin a retired model."""
+
+    _EXAMPLES = Path(__file__).parent.parent.parent / "examples"
+    _RETIRED = "claude-sonnet-4-5"
+
+    def test_claude_provider_examples_do_not_pin_retired_model(self) -> None:
+        pinned = []
+        for path in sorted(self._EXAMPLES.glob("*.yaml")):
+            config = load_config(path)
+            if config.workflow.runtime.provider.name not in ("claude", "claude-agent-sdk"):
+                continue
+            models = [config.workflow.runtime.default_model]
+            models += [getattr(a, "model", None) for a in config.agents]
+            if self._RETIRED in models:
+                pinned.append(path.name)
+
+        assert pinned == []
